Done — all 6 tests pass. There were two bugs in `lrucache/cache.py`:

1. **`get` didn't refresh recency** (`cache.py:30`): a hit returned the value without moving the key to the most-recently-used end of the `OrderedDict`, so recently-read entries could still be evicted first. Fixed by calling `move_to_end(key)` on every valid hit.

2. **`put` evicted on in-place updates** (`cache.py:33`): the eviction check only looked at size, so overwriting an existing key in a full cache wrongly evicted the LRU entry. Fixed by evicting only when the key isn't already present, since updating an existing key doesn't grow the cache.

Both fixes are explained in `SOLUTION.md`, and `python3 -m pytest -q` reports `6 passed`.
